issues.message: The marketing footer content names "small print", which the scope and the flows do not have. Name only what a flow gives the user, or leave it out.
Link default uses `plain` look app-wide, which hides every link. Fix: Remove the `plain` look so links use the default visible look everywhere (no `look: plain` app-wide).
The Link default uses the plain look, which hides every link app-wide. Fix: Remove the plain look from the Link default and use the default underlined link look so links are visible app-wide.
